name: track diseases
domain: 轨道不平顺与信号处理
definition_zh: 轨道结构或几何状态中影响服役性能的缺陷或损伤。

complete_examples.text: The effectiveness of the method is verified by examples of track diseases, i.e., the weld-type and convex-type profile.

The theories of time-frequency analysis and energy mutation over characteristic waveforms were used to study the positioning and extraction of track irregularity characteristic wavelengths and track diseases.
